calls.title: Katie Hoesley and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Growth Book is experiencing rapid expansion, highlighted by key partnerships with firms like Anthropic and a growing user base of around 3,000, including 130 enterprises. The role outlined combines technical skills with content creation and community engagement, focusing on coding, teaching, and user feedback. Notably, the company aims to transform its Slack channel from a reactive support system into a proactive collaboration environment. Katie Hoesley, the candidate, has extensive experience in developer relations and has successfully scaled developer communities, aligning well with Growth Book's needs. The hiring process includes a multi-step interview focused on communication and strategic thinking, with the company keen on quick progression.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, Developer Relations, Open Source Community, A/B Testing, Developer Engagement, Product Enablement
